patterns.note: Content is primarily centered within a maximum width, with generous vertical spacing between distinct sections, some of which use a full-width light grey background for visual separation.
Headings are consistently large, bold, and sans-serif, creating a strong visual hierarchy, while body text is highly legible and uses the same font family for a cohesive feel.
A high-contrast palette of white and dark grey/black is accented by a distinct pink/red for interactive elements like links and call-to-action text, reinforcing brand identity.

The header dynamically transforms upon scroll, shrinking in height and gaining an opaque white background, while content sections below the hero reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport.
Sections are introduced with large, centered headlines and often feature a grid of image-based cards (e.g., success stories, ways to get involved) that maintain a consistent visual style.

technique_notes: A sticky header dynamically changes its size, background color, and text color based on the user's scroll position, transitioning from a transparent overlay to a compact, opaque navigation bar.
Scroll-triggered animations reveal content sections with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, creating a sense of progression and engagement.
A full-bleed video hero plays automatically in the background, setting an emotional tone, while initial hero text and call-to-action elements are overlaid and scroll naturally over the video.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (H1 ~3-4x body) establish clear hierarchy, complemented by a readable body text size.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied consistently to buttons, image cards, and the video player, softening the overall aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major content sections and a comfortable rhythm within component grids.

standout: The site effectively leverages a prominent, emotionally resonant video hero to immediately convey its mission, seamlessly integrating the trusted Airbnb brand aesthetic with a clear, direct, and empathetic non-profit message. The storytelling approach, combined with a clean, modern design, makes the impact feel tangible and accessible.
